Markets.title: Sebi proposes tighter curbs on promotional claims by online bond platforms
Markets.summary: Sebi has proposed stricter advertising rules for online bond platforms to protect investors from making hasty financial decisions. Under the new guidelines, promotional content must include standardized security information, explicit risk disclaimers for terms like "fixed returns," and restrictions on ambiguous claims such as "high yield."
